name: omnisense/omnilang
description: Omnilang: translate a text or a page, whatever the engine, under any PHP host - plain text or HTML with its tags kept, formality where the engine has it, the source language detected, glossaries, whole documents. Four contracts (translate, detect, glossary, documents), a registry that falls back from one engine to the next, providers as packages of their own (omnilang/deepl, omnilang/google, omnilang/azure, omnilang/amazon, omnilang/libretranslate), each declaring its usage policy (rate limits, rights, attribution, data retention), enforced on every call and tightened by a site's configuration - on omnisense/contracts.

suggest.omnilang/deepl: DeepL API: translate (text, HTML, formality), glossaries, documents; a key
suggest.omnilang/google: Google Cloud Translation - Advanced (v3): translate, detect, glossaries, documents; an OAuth access token
suggest.omnilang/azure: Azure AI Translator: translate, detect, documents; a key and its region
suggest.omnilang/amazon: Amazon Translate: translate (formality), terminologies, documents; IAM credentials (Signature Version 4)
suggest.omnilang/libretranslate: LibreTranslate, self-hosted (AGPL-3.0): translate, detect, files; no key by default
